subject: Docs review: final URLs + redirects for guided onboarding (checklist + troubleshooting)
body:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Docs review: final URLs + redirects for guided onboarding (checklist + troubleshooting)

Hey all — quick docs review request so we can lock Console deep links and not churn URLs in beta.

Proposed canonical URLs (stable + versionable):
1) First request (Hosted API)
   /docs/hosted-api/quickstart/first-request
2) Streaming
   /docs/hosted-api/guides/streaming
3) Tool calling
   /docs/hosted-api/guides/tool-calling
4) Structured output
   /docs/hosted-api/guides/structured-output
5) Retries + timeouts
   /docs/hosted-api/guides/retries-and-timeouts
6) Rate limits + quotas
   /docs/hosted-api/guides/rate-limits-and-quotas
7) Usage analytics (Console)
   /docs/console/usage/overview
8) Troubleshooting (common onboarding failures)
   /docs/hosted-api/troubleshooting
9) “First production launch”
   /docs/hosted-api/production/first-production-launch

Redirect plan:
- We’ll keep existing legacy paths working via redirects for at least 90 days post-GA.
- We’ll add a minimal set of short vanity redirects (e.g., /docs/first-request → canonical) but only if Console *needs* them; otherwise we should deep link to canonical.

Ask:
1) Marissa/Nikhil — can you confirm these align with checklist step ordering + what the Console will link to? (Also confirming what you consider the “Usage analytics” destination)
2) Tessa — any objections to /production/first-production-launch as the “production checklist” anchor? Copy/IA-wise it’s the cleanest place to keep it.
3) Ownership question: we can implement redirects in redwood-docs, but we need a single owner for “link correctness” from Console (UTMs + version-stable links). Is that Console team (ENG-23123) or Docs?

Attaching the URL map + proposed redirect list.

—
Elliot Price
Director, Technical Documentation
Redwood Inference

Attachment: docs-url-map-guided-onboarding-2026-02-10.pdf
Attachment: redirects-proposal-guided-onboarding.csv


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 10:01 AM PST
Subject: Re: Docs review: final URLs + redirects for guided onboarding (checklist + troubleshooting)

These look good. Two notes:
- For “Usage analytics” our step deep link is currently a Console route (Usage Dashboard) rather than docs. We want the checklist CTA to open Console by default, but also include a “Learn more” link to docs.
- For UTM conventions: Design has a spec for docs deep links (DES-115). We’re planning to include step_id + surface=console-checklist.

Re ownership: Console team can own *building* the URLs (UTMs) + link correctness, but would like Docs to own redirects in the docs repo.

If you’re good with that split, we’ll reflect it in ENG-23123.

-Marissa


From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 10:24 AM PST
Subject: Re: Docs review: final URLs + redirects for guided onboarding (checklist + troubleshooting)

+1 on the canonical list.

Only change request: can we ensure the troubleshooting page explicitly covers:
- 401 due to wrong key environment (test vs prod)
- 429 handling (backoff + quotas)
- streaming disconnect (reconnect guidance)

We’ve got multiple support tickets on those, and the checklist will point there for “Stuck?” cases.

Also, I’d prefer /docs/hosted-api/troubleshooting vs /docs/troubleshooting to keep scope clear.

Thanks,
Nikhil


From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 11:13 AM PST
Subject: Re: Docs review: final URLs + redirects for guided onboarding (checklist + troubleshooting)

No objections on /production/first-production-launch.

One request: please avoid changing slugs during beta even if we tweak titles/copy. We can change headings and nav labels, but keeping URLs stable is critical for the checklist.

For “Learn more” links, consistent naming:
- “Retries & timeouts”
- “Rate limits & quotas”
- “Troubleshooting”

Tessa


From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 12:07 PM PST
Subject: Re: Docs review: final URLs + redirects for guided onboarding (checklist + troubleshooting)

Great — we’ll lock slugs for beta.

On troubleshooting: aligned. We’re already adding those items in the troubleshooting PR (redwood-docs #1931). I’ll make sure the sections match the checklist language exactly (test vs prod key, 429 rate limits vs quotas, streaming disconnect).

Ownership proposal (confirming):
- Docs team owns redirects + canonical URLs in docs repo.
- Console team owns: the actual link strings shipped in UI (including UTMs) + monitoring 404s from checklist clickthrough.

Marissa — for the Usage step, we can do:
- Primary CTA: “Open Usage dashboard” (Console route)
- Secondary link: /docs/console/usage/overview

I’ll update the URL map doc and comment on ENG-23123 with the finalized list.

—Elliot


From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 1:36 PM PST
Subject: Re: Docs review: final URLs + redirects for guided onboarding (checklist + troubleshooting)

Thanks. Please also ensure we have an explicit redirect policy written down (where, how long, and who approves removing old routes).

We’ve been burned before by silent doc URL churn breaking in-product UX.

If Docs can add a short “Redirects & URL stability” section to the onboarding IA update, that’d be ideal.

-Alex


From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 3:41 PM PST
Subject: Re: Docs review: final URLs + redirects for guided onboarding (checklist + troubleshooting)

Will do.

Plan:
- Add a “URL stability + redirects” section to the onboarding IA update doc + link it from the checklist PR description.
- Redirect SLA: keep legacy redirects for 90 days post-GA minimum; longer for any link used in-product (Console / emails / release notes).
- Removal requires: (1) 404 dashboard check is clean for 14 days, (2) PM sign-off (Marissa/Nikhil), (3) Docs sign-off.

I’ll also add a lightweight 404 check to our docs deploy checklist and we’ll partner with Console to monitor checklist clickthrough errors.

—
Elliot Price
Director, Technical Documentation
Redwood Inference
